category_rule: Count distinct positive (category_id,item_id) pairs in fit rows; exclude missing, empty and unknown categories. Score candidates using the Popular fit category.
split: unsigned first byte of SHA256(UTF8 user_id) < 128 selects, otherwise confirms
selection: largest unrounded selection NDCG among H1,H2,H3; ties H1,H2,H3 in order; H0 remains comparator
cost_rule: at most the frozen Popular and ItemCF builds plus per-user category counts; serial in-memory candidate p95 <= 10 ms on each evaluation window
short_list: replace only if designated slot exists
full_validation: after lock, reuse per-user observations; additional arms on remaining users for pooled description only
